title: Full Collapse Is Suboptimal: Controlled Partial Neural Collapse for Long-Tailed Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.36460v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent long-tailed recognition (LTR) methods incorporate neural collapse (NC) and align features to a fixed Equiangular Tight Frame (ETF) as a uniform target for all classes. However, forcing tail classes to fully collapse over-contracts their samples and weakens generalization. To address this, we propose a controlled partial neural collapse, realized through two coordinated controls on a backbone: the Class-Adaptive Sparse Activation (CASA) classifier and the ETF-constrained adaptive margin (ETF-AM) loss. Rather than forcing a uniform full collapse, this regime allows head classes to collapse along the ETF while tail classes retain within-class diversity. This prevents the tail from being forced into full collapse, which is suboptimal under imbalance. To set the dimensionality of collapse, CASA induces class-related node specialization through feature-conditioned gating so that tail classes occupy their own feature directions. For th

translated_title: 完全坍缩是次优的：面向长尾识别的受控部分神经坍缩
translated_abstract: 近期的长尾识别（LTR）方法引入了神经坍缩（NC），并将特征对齐到一个固定的等角紧框架（ETF），作为所有类别的统一目标。然而，强制尾部类别完全坍缩会过度收缩其样本并削弱泛化能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种受控的部分神经坍缩方法，通过对骨干网络的两项协同控制来实现：类别自适应稀疏激活（CASA）分类器和ETF约束的自适应间隔（ETF-AM）损失。该方法并非强制所有类别统一地完全坍缩，而是允许头部类别沿ETF坍缩，同时让尾部类别保留类内多样性。这避免了尾部类别被强制进行完全坍缩——这种做法在不平衡条件下是次优的。为了设定坍缩的维度，CASA通过基于特征的条件门控诱导与类别相关的节点特化，使尾部类别占据各自的特征方向。
tldr: 提出受控部分神经坍缩方法，通过CASA分类器和ETF-AM损失让头部类别沿ETF坍缩而尾部类别保留类内多样性，解决了长尾识别中强制完全坍缩导致的过度收缩与泛化能力下降问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a controlled partial neural collapse method using a CASA classifier and ETF-AM loss, allowing head classes to collapse along the ETF while tail classes retain within-class diversity, thereby addressing the over-contraction and weakened generalization caused by forcing full collapse in long-tailed recognition.
